events.body:
C1: The driver took the $6.61 cancellation fee off a RydeX trip (non-taxi), so NS-0 routes the fee through NS-1: it stands only if he tapped "I'm Here", GPS put him within the pickup range at that moment, and he waited more than 3 minutes there. [F4 F6 F7] [NS-0 NS-1]
C2: Requirement (iii) of NS-1 is not met: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:45 (F6) and cancelled at 13:05:40 (F4), and the record shows he stayed within 200 m for only 2 min 55 s after that tap (F6) — i.e. within the pickup range for less than the required 3:01. [F4 F6] [NS-1 NS-2]
C3: The system records confirm the short wait: the driver was stationary only 13:02:25–13:05:40, 3 min 15 s total (F3), his arrival was logged at 13:01:10 and the cancellation came 4 min 30 s later (F5) — of which less than 3 minutes falls after the "I'm Here" tap that NS-1 requires as the start of the chargeable wait. [F2 F3 F5 F6] [NS-1]
C4: The rider came out immediately after the cancellation, so there is no no-show: the driver's own last message at 13:05 says only that he had waited more than 3 minutes and was cancelling (F10), and the chat has just two timestamped messages with no unanswered arrival chase from the rider's side (F9, F11) — the rider was charged $6.61 for a trip that was abandoned by the driver (F7, F8). [F7 F9 F10 F11] [NS-1 NS-2]
C5: Because NS-1 (iii) is not satisfied, NS-2 applies and the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full; the rider's clean record (4 years, rating 4.9, 0 disputes in 90 days — F16) supports treating this as a plain fee-waiver case rather than a behavioural one. [F7 F16] [NS-2]

claims.assertion: The driver took the $6.61 cancellation fee off a RydeX trip (non-taxi), so NS-0 routes the fee through NS-1: it stands only if he tapped "I'm Here", GPS put him within the pickup range at that moment, and he waited more than 3 minutes there.

Requirement (iii) of NS-1 is not met: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:45 (F6) and cancelled at 13:05:40 (F4), and the record shows he stayed within 200 m for only 2 min 55 s after that tap (F6) — i.e. within the pickup range for less than the required 3:01.
